title: Identify the affine-space right tower with twisted inverse image
statement: Let N>0, let A be a finite commutative ring killed by N, and let S be Noetherian with N invertible on S. For every d, the explicit reversed right tower R_d of [def-amb-affine-space-adjunction-tower] is naturally isomorphic to exact inverse image along X_d→S followed by derived tensor with the degree-zero finite Tate sheaf A_(X_d)(d), followed by shift [2d]. This is an isomorphism of functors on the entire unbounded derived categories, and asserts no adjunction.

source.place: Proof of cor-amb-affine-space-adjunction: successive affine-line projections and addition of twists

proof.text: For d=0 the Tate sheaf is the coefficient unit. The single-unit comparison, right unitor and zero shift identify twisted inverse image with the zero right tower.

For the successor step expand the concrete projective-line right functor. Exact inverse image equals its left derived functor. Move shifts and twists through q_d* and j_d* with the finite twist pullback comparison. Inverse-image composition and the coordinate chart identity give the inverse image along X_(d+1)→S.

The finite Tate sheaves are flat by the finite-twist-line theorem, since invertibility pulls back from S. Their degree-zero singles therefore tensor to the single of the sheaf tensor. Associate the tensor factors; the Tate power recursion, with the scalar unitor when d=0, gives A(d+1). Combine shifts [2d] and [2] to [2(d+1)]. All these operations are natural, so whiskering the induction isomorphism completes the induction.

theorem nonempty_ambientTowerRightComparison (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S] (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))) (d : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (ambientTowerRight A N hA S d ≅
      ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (ambientAffine S d ↘ S)).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        derivedTensorRight (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (ambientAffine S d)
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
            (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateTwist (ambientAffine S d) N A hA d))) ⋙
        shiftFunctor _ (2 * (d : ℤ)))
